name: Breezy Cottage/Rutherford Island
description: Welcome to Breezy Cottage — A Classic Maine Riverfront Escape! Step back in time and experience the charm of coastal Maine at Breezy Point, an authentic riverfront cottage dating back to the late 1890s to early 1900s. Nestled along the scenic Gut and Damariscotta River, this historic retreat offers timeless beauty, serene views, and the soothing rhythm of boats passing by. Sip your morning coffee on the porch as you watch local fishermen navigate the waterways, the soft hum of their motors blending into the natural stillness around you.

name: Dale Camp/Damariscotta
description: Experience the quintessential Maine summer getaway at this charming lakeside cottage on Cranberry Point Lane, nestled along the shores of Pemaquid Lake in Damariscotta. This classic four-bedroom, one-and-a-half-bath retreat offers the perfect blend of comfort, charm, and outdoor adventure. Start your mornings with coffee on the screened-in porch, spend sunny afternoons paddling the lake with the included kayak and canoe or a relalxing siesta in the inviting hammock while listening to waves lapping the shore, and wind down with a rinse in the refreshing outdoor shower.

Surrounded by ocean water on two sides, the home features westerly-facing vistas from nearly every room — making it an ideal spot for relaxing, gathering, and creating lasting memories. A highlight of the property is the expansive wrap-around deck that spans the length of the home, offering multiple seating areas and unbeatable sunset views.

name: Seaworthy Cottage/New Harbor
description: Seaworthy – A Perfect Maine Coast Location Welcome to Seaworthy, a beautifully restored 1929 fisherman’s cottage overlooking one of Maine’s most picturesque working harbors in New Harbor, Maine. Blending timeless New England charm with thoughtful modern updates, Seaworthy offers an authentic Maine experience filled with warmth, comfort, and stunning coastal views. Classic Charm Meets Modern Comfort Step inside to find a lovingly renovated home that celebrates original Maine craftsmanship while providing every modern convenience. Gleaming wood floors run throughout the cottage, complemented by art, antiques, and nautical touches that tell the story of its maritime heritage.
